_readme: Reconstructed format, same as the other modules. Only post_message makes a real network call and has NOT been tested against a real workspace yet. build_summary_blocks, verify_slack_signature, parse_slash_command and parse_interactive_payload are pure logic, tested without mocks or network, and can be trusted without external validation. Validate post_message with 'railcall module validate module_spec.json' and a test Slack workspace before publishing.
description: Publishes Fika Sync's weekly/daily summary to Slack with interactive buttons, and verifies/parses incoming /fika-check requests and clicks on 'Adjust my threshold'. Requires SLACK_BOT_TOKEN and SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.

actions.name: verify_slack_signature
actions.note: Critical security piece: without this, anyone could forge a click on 'Adjust my threshold' or a /fika-check.
